118_erra_threshold.grounding: Wikipedia ORES publishes precision/recall per operating point; consumers pick the point.
118_erra_threshold.mechanism: Erra publishes a precision/recall curve per vertical. Policy picks the operating point explicitly. Buyer-facing answer is the curve, not a hardcoded cutoff.
118_erra_threshold.opsec_note: Item 138: prefer banded ranges or ZK consistency proofs over exact cutoffs (item 51 research).

119_gate_interlock.grounding: IEC 61511: sensor → logic solver → final element; voting; SIL; proof-test interval.
119_gate_interlock.borrowed: Scheduled, logged proof-test that BLOCK still trips.

120_mishara_harm_tiers.grounding: Thorn: exact-match hash (auto) vs predictive classifier (human only) vs provenance/watermark (orthogonal).
120_mishara_harm_tiers.mechanism: Three-tier split. Never auto-act on classifier-only.

121_verra_step_up.grounding: 3DS2 ACS risk score; frictionless vs challenge; liability shift by flow.
121_verra_step_up.mechanism: High-confidence binds clear; weak matches step up. Not uniform strictness.

122_named_assumptions.grounding: Hardware verification: proof vs test; vacuous proof if assumptions exclude the breaking case.
122_named_assumptions.mechanism: verified receipts are { verified: true, under_assumptions: [..] }, never verified: true alone.
